factors.value_notes: The species account documents a deep reef-associated grouper (approximately 12–439 m); a 2024 deep-sea lander study reports a single observation at 470 m and 15.79 °C. These are habitat/deep-bottom observations, not thermal preference evidence and do not validate the configured 12–24 °C SST range or 15–20 °C ideal. No defensible surface-temperature source was found.
